job.title: PackInfer: Compute- and I/O-Efficient Attention for Batched LLM Inference
job.selection_reason: 異なるsequence lengthを含むbatch推論でcompute/I-O imbalanceを抑えるattention kernel framework。request packingとshared-prefix I/O-aware grouping、KV layout再編で実workload上latency 13.0〜20.1%削減、FlashAttention比throughput 20%改善を報告し、serving向けkernel/runtime系統の重要候補。
